text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear pro-driverless thesis and repeated stance","quality":"stance clarity","description":"The essay states its position early and keeps reinforcing the same argument throughout."},{"evidence":"\"First,\" \"Driverless cars can make...\" \"These cars can change...\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay uses a more developed paragraph structure and transitions to separate its reasons."},{"evidence":"Google’s half-million miles without a crash; alerts for driveways and traffic issues","quality":"use of evidence","description":"The essay supports claims with multiple specific details drawn from the article."},{"evidence":"\"can help make our lives easier and better\"; \"make car rides more fun\"","quality":"reason development","description":"The essay gives more than one reason and expands on how driverless cars could benefit people."},{"evidence":"\"How awesome is that!\" \"Let me answer that question for you.\"","quality":"persuasive voice","description":"The writing sounds more intentionally argumentative and engaging, with rhetorical questions and emphatic commentary."}]}
